title: Independent repositories for Tarium projects
summary: Maintain each Tarium candidate or enrolled project's implementation, ontology, gallery, datasets and research resources in its own repository; the central Tarium hub hosts only its authorized registry, governance, validation tooling and reusable templates.
statement: Maintain each Tarium candidate or enrolled project's implementation, ontology, gallery, datasets and research resources in its own repository; the central Tarium hub hosts only its authorized registry, governance, validation tooling and reusable templates.
rationale: Tarium's public constitution defines a specialized, independently selectable project requirement. Overlap with general Nomos guidance is intentionally preserved and auditable.

conditions: The task concerns an independently authorized public Tarium candidate or member project.
exceptions: This rule does not authorize Tarium membership changes, private-material disclosure, or unrelated repository operations.

preconditions: The user has separately authorized the relevant project task; Tarium membership remains a separately approved operation.
exclusions: No automatic cross-repository action, enrollment, or publication of nonpublic source data.

authority.source: Reviewed public-document normalization candidate, retained for provenance
